questions.qtext: Which of the following statements is correct about reaction turbine?

options.text: Pressure drops only in nozzles and not in moving blade channels.
Occupies less space for same power compare to impulse turbine.

questions.solution:
(b)
For reaction turbine,
• Pressure drops in fixed blades (nozzles) as well as moving blade channels.
• They are suitable for medium and higher power requirements.
• Occupies more space for same power and blade manufacturing process is difficult compared
to impulse and hence costly.
questions.subject: Technical

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement is not correct about regenerative feedwater heating for the same turbine output?

options.text: The cycle efficiency will remain same.
For same boiler output, turbine output is decreased.

questions.solution:
(a)
The effects of regenerative feedwater heating for the same turbine output is
1. It increases the cycle efficiency and reduces the heat rate.
2. It increases the steam flow rate to boiler due to which boiler size increases.
3. It reduces the steam flow rate to condenser, due to which condenser size decreases.
4. If the boiler output is kept constant, the turbine output will decrease.
questions.subject: Technical
